evidence.section: LC–MS untargeted metabolomics profiling from plasma samples
evidence.quote: We performed untargeted metabolomics to analyze plasma metabolites in a cohort of younger and older subjects before and after influenza vaccination to identify vaccine‐induced molecular signatures.
